cast.name: 肯·范德马克 肯·范德马克

introduction: Part evocative city symphony, part in-depth look at Chicago’s role in the movement of post-rock music of the 1990s, PARALLAX SOUNDS blends vibrant images of the city’s distinctive architecture and the urban landscape in motion with interviews with musicians including Steve Albini, Ken Vandermark, Ian Williams, Damon Locks, David Grubbs, and more. An original soundtrack by Vandermark features two new songs by Grubbs and musicians John Herndon, Wayne Montana, Jason Adasiewicz, Terrie Hessels, and Nate Wooley.
